Container.Name: DiscVault (beta)
Container.Overview: Beta (English): the development version of the app, built from its beta branch. It can be unstable and can change the database in ways the stable version cannot read. It has its own app data folder and port, so it runs next to the stable app. Do not point it at the data of the stable app.[br][br]Bèta (Nederlands): de ontwikkelversie van de app, gebouwd vanaf de beta-branch. Hij kan onstabiel zijn en de database aanpassen op een manier die de stabiele versie niet kan lezen. Hij heeft een eigen data-map en poort, dus hij draait naast de stabiele app. Gebruik de data van de stabiele app niet voor de beta.[br][br]English: DiscVault is a self-hosted manager for your 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD collection: barcode scanning, metadata lookup, posters, watchlist, users and groups, passkey sign-in, backup and restore, and an MCP endpoint for AI assistants. It needs a PostgreSQL database, so this template installs the DiscVault launcher: one container that creates and updates the whole stack (PostgreSQL, API, worker and MCP) through the Docker socket and serves it on one port. Mounting the Docker socket gives the launcher control over Docker on your server. Passkeys only work on an https address with a domain name: put a reverse proxy in front of it and fill in RP_ID and RP_ORIGINS.[br][br]Nederlands: DiscVault is een zelf te hosten beheerder voor je 4K UHD-, Blu-ray- en dvd-collectie: barcodes scannen, metadata opzoeken, posters, kijklijst, gebruikers en groepen, inloggen met passkeys, back-up en terugzetten, en een MCP-eindpunt voor AI-assistenten. Het heeft een PostgreSQL-database nodig, dus deze template installeert de DiscVault-launcher: een container die de hele stack (PostgreSQL, API, worker en MCP) via de Docker-socket aanmaakt en bijwerkt en op een poort aanbiedt. De Docker-socket geeft de launcher controle over Docker op je server. Passkeys werken alleen op een https-adres met een domeinnaam: zet er een reverse proxy voor en vul RP_ID en RP_ORIGINS in.

Config.Name: Release channel
Config.Description: Which DiscVault release to run: latest (production), beta, auto (the channel built into this launcher image) or manual (the image below). / Welke DiscVault-release draait.

Config.Name: DiscVault image (manual channel only)
Config.Description: Only used when the release channel is manual: a tag such as v26.10.17 or a full image reference; digest pinning is supported (ghcr.io/helmerznl/discvault:beta@sha256:DIGEST) and turns automatic updates off. / Alleen bij kanaal manual.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the DiscVault web interface; the launcher proxies it to the app (and /mcp to the MCP server). / Poort van de webinterface.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: DiscVault data: posters, profiles, backups. / DiscVault-gegevens: posters, profielen, back-ups.

Config.Name: App data on the host
Config.Description: The same folder as App data above, as the Docker host sees it; it must be identical. / Dezelfde map als App data, zoals de Docker-host hem ziet; moet identiek zijn.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL data on the host
Config.Description: Folder for the PostgreSQL data. Use a folder of its own: PostgreSQL only reads the password when it first initialises it. / Map voor de PostgreSQL-gegevens; gebruik een eigen map.

Config.Name: Launcher config
Config.Description: Launcher state, the generated Compose file, generated secrets and boot logs. / Status van de launcher, gegenereerde secrets en logboeken.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required so the launcher can create and update the DiscVault stack. Mounting the Docker socket gives this container control over Docker on your server, which is how the launcher manages the stack. Only install it if you trust the launcher image. / Het koppelen van de Docker-socket geeft deze container controle over Docker op je server; zo beheert de launcher de stack.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container and stack timezone; change it to yours. / Tijdzone van de container en de stack.

Config.Name: Passkey domain (RP_ID)
Config.Description: The domain DiscVault is opened on, without scheme or port, for example vault.example.com. Empty means localhost, which only works on the server itself. Passkeys are bound to it. / Het domein waarop DiscVault wordt geopend.

Config.Name: Passkey addresses (RP_ORIGINS)
Config.Description: The full address(es) in the browser, comma separated, for example https://vault.example.com. Empty means http://localhost:6080. / Het volledige adres in de browser.

Config.Name: Passkey name (RP_NAME)
Config.Description: The name your browser shows with a passkey. / De naam die je browser bij een passkey toont.

Config.Name: Password sign-in
Config.Description: Opt-in password and two-step verification sign-in; passkeys remain the recommended method. An existing install also has to enable it in Users and roles with a fresh passkey. / Inloggen met wachtwoord naast passkeys.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password
Config.Description: Optional, stable. Empty: the launcher makes one in /config/stack.env on the first start. It only takes effect when the PostgreSQL folder is first initialised.

Config.Name: JWT secret
Config.Description: Optional, stable signing secret. Empty: the launcher makes one in /config/stack.env on the first start. Never change it afterwards.

Config.Name: Key encryption key
Config.Description: Optional separate key for the MovieVault credentials stored in PostgreSQL. Empty derives them from the JWT secret. Setting it on an existing install makes stored credentials unreadable, so set it before first use.

Config.Name: Compose project name
Config.Description: Name of the Docker Compose project of the managed stack. Give every parallel install its own value.

Config.Name: Stack network
Config.Description: Docker network of the managed stack. Give every parallel install its own value.

Config.Name: Always recreate stack
Config.Description: Recreate the stack at every start after pulling the images. For troubleshooting.

Config.Name: Check health SHA after deploy
Config.Description: Verify the revision reported by /api/next/health against the deployed image and fail the start on a mismatch.

Config.Name: Resync PostgreSQL password
Config.Description: When PostgreSQL rejects the password, run ALTER USER to make it match the launcher configuration. This writes to your database; leave off unless you know the configured password is the one you want.

Config.Name: Admin dedup execution
Config.Description: Enables the destructive duplicate merge in the admin area. Keep off unless you reviewed the matching and report workflow.

Config.Name: Boot log retention
Config.Description: How many launcher boot logs to keep in /config/logs.

Config.Name: Rollout lock timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: How long the launcher waits for the rollout lock before the start fails, to avoid update races.
